shadows.name: raised
shadows.purpose: Cards, stat panels, sidebar. Standard surface elevation above the canvas.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: Modals, dropdowns, popovers. Highest elevation level.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default transition for background-color and border-color changes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action per screen. Directive Indigo signals importance.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #4f46e5; color: #ffffff; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4338ca; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4f46e5; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting actions. White background, Chalk Line border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #ffffff; color: #374151; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f9fafb; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #d1d5db; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive actions: cancel booking, delete record.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #dc2626; color: #ffffff; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #b91c1c; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #dc2626; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-danger:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form input with label and optional error state.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #374151; } .ds-input { width: 100%; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 14px; color: #111827; background: #ffffff; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #9ca3af; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #4f46e5; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(79,70,229,0.15); } .ds-input.ds-input-error { border-color: #ef4444; } .ds-field-error { font-size: 12px; color: #dc2626; margin-top: 2px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Booking status indicator. Text + surface color pair, always together.
components.html: ConfirmedIn ProgressCompletedCancelledPending
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-badge-confirmed { background: #eff6ff; color: #1d4ed8; } .ds-badge-progress { background: #fffbeb; color: #b45309; } .ds-badge-done { background: #f0fdf4; color: #15803d; } .ds-badge-cancelled { background: #fef2f2; color: #b91c1c; } .ds-badge-pending { background: #f3f4f6; color: #4b5563; }

components.description: Sidebar navigation link. Active state uses Indigo Veil + Directive Indigo.

narrative.overview:
WashFlow operates like a well-organized workbench: every tool is visible and in its place, nothing competes for attention, and the work gets done without ceremony. The interface recedes behind the task.

The palette is gray-on-white with a single directive accent. Surfaces lift slightly off the canvas. Typography is system sans at considered weights. There is no decoration that doesn't carry information.

This system explicitly rejects three failure modes: the generic Tailwind UI kit clone, the over-engineered enterprise dashboard, and the cheap service-industry app aesthetic.
keyCharacteristics: Gray-on-white foundation with one directional accent (Directive Indigo, used to orient, not decorate)
Slightly lifted surfaces: ambient shadow separates card from canvas
System sans throughout: no display fonts, hierarchy through weight and size contrast
Status conveyed through semantic chips only, never painted onto full surfaces
Flat tables and lists; cards only where content is genuinely grouped

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Directive Indigo (#4f46e5) is the only accent. It appears on the primary action and the active nav item per screen. Never used as a background tint, a gradient ingredient, or a decorative fill.

rules.name: The Contained Status Rule
rules.body: Status colors (confirmed/progress/done/cancelled) are always used as a text+surface pair inside a chip. Never applied as standalone text on white, as card backgrounds, or as full-width banners.

rules.name: The Weight-Before-Size Rule
rules.body: Before reaching for a larger font size to create emphasis, try 500 or 600 weight at the current size. This keeps the scale compact and avoids a jumpy hierarchy.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Elements do not acquire shadows on hover as decoration. Hover state is expressed through background-color shift. Shadows mark permanent structural hierarchy, not interactivity.

dos: Do use Directive Indigo (#4f46e5) only on the primary action and active nav item per screen.
Do use the full status color pair (text + surface tint) together inside chips.
Do express hover state through background-color shift: gray-50 for secondary buttons, gray-100 for ghost/nav items.
Do apply the Raised shadow to all cards and stat panels. Apply the Floating shadow to modals and dropdowns.
Do use Workshop Canvas (#f9fafb) as the page background and Bare Surface (#ffffff) as the card/surface layer.
Do cap content text columns at 65ch on detail and form pages.
Do use 12px/500/uppercase/tracking-wide exclusively for structural metadata: table column headers, sidebar group labels.
donts: Don't use a border-left greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe on cards, list items, or alerts.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text with a gradient fill). Emphasis is weight or size, never a gradient.
Don't use glassmorphism, blur backdrops, or semi-transparent surface overlays.
Don't build identical icon + heading + body card grids.
Don't apply the generic Tailwind-kit aesthetic unmodified.
Don't add elevation to hover state. Shadow is structural, not interactive.
Don't bleed service-industry aesthetics into the product shell: neon buttons, stock-photo panels, clip-art iconography.
Don't stack enterprise-style nav layers or modal-on-modal patterns.
Don't introduce new accent colors for one-off states.
